emotional_tone: Authoritative, Precise, Command-Center Clarity, High-Trust Financial Control
theme_mode: Support both Light (default Executive Slate/Clean Sand) and Dark (Deep Slate/Obsidian) theme toggle

forbidden_fonts: Inter for main expressive titles where personality is needed

layout_strategy.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid
layout_strategy.panel_style: Cardless or subtle 1px border cards with inner padding (p-5 md:p-6), rounded-lg (8px max radius), subtle ambient shadow shadow-sm
layout_strategy.header_strategy: Sticky glassmorphism header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-900/80 (NEVER pure transparent), z-40, containing Multi-company switcher + Sync Status + Data Upload Action + Dark/Light Toggle
layout_strategy.sidebar_strategy: Fixed left sidebar on desktop (w-64), responsive drawer on mobile, listing all 5 core role dashboards (CEO, CFO, Accounts, Purchase, Sales) + Data Upload / Tally Sync Manager

ceo_dashboard.title: CEO Dashboard — Executive Strategic View
components: Business Snapshot KPI Cards (Gross vs Net Sales, Total Purchases, Total Receipts, Total Payments with MoM % growth indicators)
Liquidity & Net Cash Flow Panel (Bank Balances, Cash-in-hand, Net Working Capital gauge)
Executive Trends Chart (MoM & YoY Revenue & Gross Profit Margin area/line chart)
Toppers Watchlist Tabs (Top 5/10/30 Customers, Suppliers, and Revenue Items)
Inactive Customer/Account Alert Panel (Accounts with zero activity > 60 days with revenue impact risk)

cfo_dashboard.title: CFO Dashboard — Financial Control & Risk
components: Aging Outstanding Analysis (Receivables & Payables by >30, >60, >90, >120 day buckets with interactive bar/stacked charts)
Working Capital & Cash Flow Projections (Expected Collections vs Upcoming Liabilities with due date breakdown)
Expense Breakdown (Direct vs Indirect Expenses vs Revenue ratio donut/pie visual)
Financial Statement Overview Tabs (P&L Snapshot, Balance Sheet Summary, Trial Balance High-Level Table)

accounts_dashboard.title: Accounts Dashboard — Operational Finance & Books
components: Live Daybook Feed (Chronological searchable feed of Sales, Purchases, Payments, Receipts, Journal Vouchers)
General Ledger & Party Statements (Opening/Closing balances with modal drill-down to voucher-level transactions)
Pending Collection Dashboard (Bill-wise payment status table with overdue highlights)
Receipt & Payment Summaries (Cash vs Bank transaction breakdowns)

purchase_dashboard.title: Purchase Dashboard — Procurement & Vendor Management
components: Purchase Trends & Volume (Monthly trends & vendor-wise procurement volume charts)
Vendor Payables Table (Outstanding supplier balances, due dates, credit days remaining)
Purchase Order Tracking (Pending POs, partial delivery status indicators)
Supplier Analysis Ranking (Top suppliers by volume, billing value, and top purchased inventory items)

sales_dashboard.title: Sales Dashboard — Revenue & Sales Team Performance
components: Sales Performance Analytics (Revenue split by Customer, Stock Item, Stock Group, Region, and Sales Rep)
Pending Sales Orders Table (Unfulfilled orders, committed delivery dates)
Sales Force Automation Summary (Field rep visit logs, GPS check-in status overview)
Customer Buying Patterns (Item purchase frequency, cross-sell/upsell opportunity flags)

shared_features.company_switcher: Dropdown component to switch between Tally companies (e.g. Acme Tech Corp - Main, Acme Retail West, Acme Global Exports)
shared_features.data_upload_panel: Modal/Panel for uploading Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime XML & Excel export files or resetting back to Seeded Tally Demo Data
shared_features.date_range_picker: Shadcn DatePicker/Select for FY selection (e.g., FY 2024-25, Q1, Q2, Custom Date Range)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive, highly functional 5-role financial dashboard application using React, Lucide-react, Recharts, and Shadcn components.
Ensure Javascript (.js/.jsx) file syntax is used throughout.

Seed high-quality, realistic Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime demo data for all 5 role views (CEO, CFO, Accounts, Purchase, Sales) with realistic Indian/Global accounting formats (INR ₹ or USD $, Lakhs/Crores or Thousands/Millions toggle).
Provide a visible Multi-Company Switcher at top right/header so users can test switching between demo companies.
Provide an interactive Data Upload Modal/Drawer allowing users to upload XML or Excel files or re-seed sample Tally ERP data.
Implement drill-down modals for Daybook items and General Ledger statements to examine voucher details.
Ensure contrast meets APCA standards. DO NOT use forbidden colors (#1B93A4 teal or #7351B7 purple). Use dark slate sidebar with crisp blue (#3B82F6) and emerald (#10B981) highlights.
Include data-testid on all key navigation items, company switcher, dashboard tab buttons, data tables, and action triggers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid standard AI slop look: use sharp 1px borders, subtle backdrop blurs, dense scannable data grids, clean font hierarchies with mono tabular numbers.
Every interactive element MUST have hover, focus, and click feedback.
DO NOT use raw HTML select or raw date inputs; use Shadcn Select, Command, and Calendar/Popover components.
DO NOT use transparent header/dropdown backgrounds without backdrop blur or solid fill.
Always include data-testid attributes on interactive elements.
